recap.analyst:
Ridgeview beat Navigli United 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.55–0.00: Ridgeview created the better chances and the result reflects it.

Navigli United had 57% of the ball. Pass completion RID 81% (57/70), NAV 81% (90/111). Shots 4–0, on target 1–0.

Ridgeview started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Navigli United in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: NAV to 4-2-3-1 at 65' (chasing the game); RID to 5-4-1 at 79' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 6': Ridgeview broke the deadlock through P. Petit. The chance was worth xG 0.29 (about 29 in 100 go in), struck at 78 km/h. Score now RID 1-0 NAV. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: B. Pavlov completed the most passes (18); T. Arbeloa hit the top speed (33.6 km/h); N. Fofana covered the most ground (3.61 km, a 10.3 km per-90 pace); N. Okoro won the most challenges (7).

Discipline: fouls 2–2, yellows 1–1, offsides 0–0. Conditions: partly cloudy, 19°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. P. Petit broke the deadlock in the 6th minute. Navigli United pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 65th minute, but Ridgeview held firm. The hero: P. Petit, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Ridgeview celebrate in front of their fans.
